WoW Forever Rogue builds, the most popularFrom 13,324 Rogue builds with 41 or more points planned on this site, since the Nov 2 hotfixes to build 70753, recounted a few times a day. Counted by this site's own counter, no identities. WoW Forever launches 4 November 2026; until then these are builds for the beta trees, and the count starts again when a patch changes them.

7,687 of the 13,324 Rogue builds with 41 or more points planned here (58%) lead in Subtlety, 3,050 in Combat and 2,587 in Assassination. Weighted by what people did with each build (made, viewed, opened by link, shared or saved), Subtlety has 52%, Combat 26% and Assassination 22%. At the level 30 cap the most made 21-point build leads in Combat instead. 39.1% of the Rogue leveling orders people recorded lead in Subtlety. Every build below opens in the Rogue calculator, and the Rogue leveling order shows the order people place these points in.

Builds within a few points of each other count as one family, shown by its most used member. The rows and the spec split come from the 13,324 Rogue builds with 41 or more points planned here since the Nov 2 hotfixes to build 70753, ranked by what people did with each family since then: a share or a save weighs 5, a link open 3, making the build 2 and a view 1. The shared, saved and opened counts run from 13 Sep, before the beta: a row's share is its family's shares, saves and link opens over every Rogue build's (4,517 shares, 9,036 saves, 79,735 link opens since 13 Sep), so a row can hold a larger share than one ranked above it.

Since 13 Sep, 95,211 Rogue builds were made, shared, saved or opened here and 10,242 of them have all 51 points, those today's trees no longer allow included; this list counts the 13,324 with 41 or more points that today's trees allow, since the Nov 2 hotfixes to build 70753.

Players tag a build Leveling, PvE or PvP in the "What's it for?" row of the Rogue calculator; a tag counts once they have saved or shared that build, one a day each. A build is listed with 3 tags on two days, named only once two or more people used it on the same day, and only for what at least half as many of its tags say as its most said purpose. Tank, healer or DPS is read from the talents. Tags say what players use a build for, not how strong it is.

This is a count of what people plan on this site, not a tier list. When a beta build moves, adds, removes or renames a Rogue talent or changes what it needs first, the count starts again from the day after that build and shows once 1,000 builds with 41 or more points are made on the new trees, as it did after the Nov 2 hotfixes to build 70753.

Rogue talents by pick rate, most and least taken

Most taken: Malice 87% (Assassination), Coup de Grace 81% (Combat), Opportunity 76% (Subtlety), Ruthlessness 68% (Assassination), Efficient Strikes 68% (Combat). Least taken: Improved Kidney Shot 3% (Assassination), Improved Kick 4% (Combat), Remorseless Attacks 14% (Assassination), Mutilate 16% (Assassination), Adrenaline Rush 17% (Combat). Share of Rogue builds with 41 or more points that have a point in the talent, each build counted once.

Questions

Which Rogue spec do people build most in WoW Forever?
7,687 of the 13,324 Rogue builds with 41 or more points planned here (58%) lead in Subtlety, 3,050 in Combat and 2,587 in Assassination, counted since the Nov 2 hotfixes to build 70753. Weighted by what people did with each build (made, viewed, opened by link, shared or saved), Subtlety has 52%, Combat 26% and Assassination 22%. At the level 30 cap the most made 21-point build leads in Combat instead. 39.1% of the Rogue leveling orders people recorded lead in Subtlety.
What is the most popular Rogue build at level 30, the beta cap?
Combat 0/21/0: 10.5% of the 457 level 30 Rogue builds counted between 1 and 16 Oct 2026 (48 people-days), maxing Coup de Grace, Efficient Strikes, Deflection, Precision, Endurance, Riposte and 2 more. Since this count, Dual Wield Specialization has 2 ranks now; the build put 4 points in it.
What is the most popular Rogue build at level 60?
Combat Rogue 15/36/0, ranked first by what people did with each build since the Nov 2 hotfixes (a share or a save weighs 5, a link open 3, making the build 2, a view 1). It holds 0.3% of every Rogue share, save and link open counted here since 13 Sep (shared 20, saved 88, opened 182).
Which Rogue talents are taken most and least?
Most taken: Malice (87%), Coup de Grace (81%) and Opportunity (76%). Least taken: Improved Kidney Shot (3%), Improved Kick (4%) and Remorseless Attacks (14%). The percentages are the share of Rogue builds with 41 or more points that have at least one point in the talent, each build counted once.
Is there a Rogue raid, dungeon or PvP build in WoW Forever yet?
The builds people tagged most for each, when they saved or shared them in the calculator. PvE: Combat Rogue 16/35/0, 10 tags. PvP: Subtlety Rogue 12/8/31, 4 tags. A build is listed once it has 3 tags for the same thing; these are tags from players, not a ranking of how strong a build is.
Is this a Rogue tier list?
No. The builds are ranked by what people did with them on this site (shared, saved, opened by link, made or viewed), not by how strong they are.
Where do these Rogue build numbers come from?
From this site's own counter, which keeps counts only and no identities: every Rogue build planned in the calculator, and how often each was shared, saved or opened by link. Builds within a few points of each other count as one family, shown by its most used member, and every spec gets at least one row. The list is rebuilt a few times a day, last on 3 Nov 2026.
